title: Researches and applications of pollution prevention and control technologies for carbon dross from electrolytic aluminium production: a review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38698-38713
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04272K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ningning Feng, Chenquan Wang, Chunqiang Chen, Xi Liu, Qiang Huo
Based on the 3C (Clean–Cycle–Control) strategy, this study reviews progress in source reduction, process recycling, and end-of-pipe treatment of aluminum electrolysis carbon dross, offering a paradigm for its low-carbon, high-value, and safe management.
